title: On a Nonuniformly Coercive Quasilinear p(·)-Elliptic Neumann Problem with L1 Data
content: This paper studies a quasilinear and nonuniformly coercive elliptic Neumann problem with both right hand sides in $L^1(\Omega)$ (PDE) and boundary data in $L^1(\partial\Omega)$, in the context of Sobolev spaces with variable exponent. We analyze the existence and the uniqueness of renormalized solutions to this problem.
